description: This file is a Smarty plugin that defines a modifier function 'debug_print_var' used for formatted display of variable contents in the Smarty templating system, mainly for debugging purposes.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_debug_print_var
methods.description: Formats a variable's content for display, handling different PHP types such as array, object, boolean, NULL, resource, integer, float, and string, with custom formatting for debugging output.
